help.mAP50: mAP50 — mean average precision over classes at IoU ≥ 0.5: the main YOLO detection metric. Computed on the Validation split of the dataset.
help.mAP50_95: mAP50-95 — the same averaged over IoU thresholds from 0.5 to 0.95: stricter about box accuracy. Ultralytics picks the best weights by it.
help.precision: Precision — the share of detections that were correct. Low means the model often sees an object where there is none.
help.recall: Recall — the share of real objects the model found. Low means the model misses a lot.
help.bestEpoch: Best epoch — the epoch with the highest Ultralytics fitness (now mAP50-95 on validation): the best.pt weights of the version come from it.
help.epochs: Epochs done of those set. Fewer than set means early stopping (patience) fired: the metrics stopped improving.
help.dataset: The dataset the version was trained on and the number of frames in the Train and Validation splits.
help.lr0: Initial learning rate (lr0). "auto" means the worker computed it from the batch.
help.batch: Batch size. If Ultralytics reduced it for lack of memory, the actual one is in brackets.
help.amp: Mixed precision (AMP): the actual value; the worker turns it off on the CPU and on some GPUs.
